summary: Iteration 4 — Bells/wallet, shop, farming economy. 25/25 backend pytest pass (7 new economy tests in test_economy_farming.py + 13 decor/rotation + 5 houses/zones regression). Frontend E2E verified via Playwright: create room, bells-badge=120, clock-badge visible ('Morning'), open shop, buy 2 tomato seeds -> 100 bells, buy lamppost -> 30 bells, close shop, inventory-slot-13 appears and selectable, place-button visible, plant-button opens seed-picker, plant-seed-tomato plants a crop in front of player, harvest-button + H key visible. Server-side rejections confirmed for overspend, double-buy-furniture, planting without seeds, harvesting unripe crops, and selling without held crops. Crop zone isolation confirmed (zone_state for house:<pid> has crops==[]). Planted crops persist across fresh WS reconnect (init.crops). Wallet messages are scoped only to the acting player.
critical_code_review_comments: IslandGame.jsx is ~1291 lines — now well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into modules: rendering (drawCrop/drawInterior/drawSky), WS message handlers, keyboard/game-loop hook, and UI panels (Shop, Decor, Chat).

Server WS economy handlers silently drop invalid actions (overspend, missing seed, unripe harvest, not-owned sell, double-buy) with no feedback to the client. Consider sending a {type:'wallet_reject', reason:'...'} so the UI could show a toast; currently clients rely on absence of a wallet message, which is a brittle contract.

db.player_state has no unique index on (code, player_id). get_state uses find_one then insert — in a tight race (two sockets of same pid joining simultaneously) duplicate player_state docs could be created. Add a unique compound index at startup.
harvest/plant handlers do NOT validate x/y bounds or sanitize numeric input (same as place). A malicious client could plant at (1e9, 1e9). Mild; low priority.
No cleanup of db.crops / db.player_state when rooms become empty — unbounded growth over time. Not blocking for MVP but worth noting.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth; name + room code join)
seed_data_creation: Each pytest test creates a fresh room via POST /api/rooms/create. test_harvest_ripeness_gate_and_credit uses direct Mongo update to backdate planted_at (per spec hint). test_sell_crop uses direct Mongo write to seed crops[] held.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All economy/farming WS flows (buy_seed, plant, harvest, sell_crop, buy_furniture) and wallet persistence/scoping covered in /app/backend/tests/test_economy_farming.py. Prior regression suites remain green. For harvest ripeness tests, backdate planted_at directly in db.crops via MONGO_URL/DB_NAME. Day/night sky is pure client-side (Date.now() 8-min cycle) and only needs visual sanity — the clock-badge label (Morning/Noon/Dusk/Night) is a good quick check. New inventory items (fountain/lamppost/arch/piano) show up as inventory-slot-13+ in order of unlock.
